Strange omen...

say:10:1510306010:0.female: Your emissary is quite perceptive, Herdmaster. The truth might not be far from her guess...

say:1:1510307002:0.source_cn: 耕犁过的农田……但没有作物。

say:3:1510310002:1.text: Doyle, I've fulfilled my promise to Perseus and brought back the captured soldiers.
